methodology.feature: within league/referee, prior 365-day home-minus-away yellow/red-card differential minus league prior differential, shrunk n/(n+5); only dates strictly earlier than target Beijing date minus 3 days; card counts must be present and nonnegative; same-day feature snapshots precede daily updates
methodology.time_forward: 2024 train 2019-2023, 2025 train 2019-2024, 2026 train 2019-2025; fixed Ridge alpha 100 after fold-local standardization; all train/test observations require at least one observed earlier referee card match; same target cohort for all methods
methodology.AH_direction: Ridge predicts home goal difference. A discretized normal margin distribution with training residual RMSE is settled against the actual Crown AH line and both decimal prices; choose higher model-expected net AH return. Low-price side is a diagnostic baseline.
methodology.temporal_limit: target referee is sourced retrospectively from games.csv.gz; no verified referee assignment announcement/receipt timestamp. All Crown path prices are historical source-event replays, not actual received prices.
